name: KDP non-fiction house style
genre: practical non-fiction books (self-help, parenting, how-to) written in Markdown
register: Plain, warm, direct; second person ('you'); short paragraphs; grade 6-8 reading level.
The pen name's brand bible (pen-names/<name>.md) is the voice authority; preserve it.
Bold is intentional for word-for-word scripts (SAY THIS lines) and card labels; do not flag or remove that bold. Flag only decorative bold elsewhere.
Headings may quote a child or parent (e.g. "I Don't Want To!"); those quotations are intentional hooks, not AI staging.
Never add statistics, studies, names, anecdotes or first-person experiences; flag the gap instead. Illustrative composite examples already in the text stay as written.
